verdict.rationale: Supabase documents that its CLI runs the entire stack locally or in a CI environment, can be pinned as an npm dev dependency, and can have telemetry disabled through environment variables. Headless automation is also documented through PAT-authenticated MCP access for CI, a published Management API OpenAPI spec (confirmed by probe), CLI-accessible advisors, and per-PR branching preview environments. Community reports on local setup are mixed: one user found it easy, while Val Town reportedly could not get local dev working. Neither contradicts the documented CI capability. Missing for 10: a documented CI pipeline recipe (e.g. GitHub Actions workflow) and non-interactive CLI auth details, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
